infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: AI Beer Sommelier needs camera access to scan barcodes and take photos of your beers.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: AI Beer Sommelier needs photo library access to add beer photos from your gallery.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: AI Beer Sommelier uses your location to tag where you enjoyed your beers and find nearby craft breweries.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: AI Beer Sommelier may need microphone access for voice commands.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow AI Beer Sommelier to access your camera to scan barcodes and capture beer photos.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow AI Beer Sommelier to use your location for brewery recommendations.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow AI Beer Sommelier to access your photos to add beer images.
